lines.text: Every session starts from zero. Your agent relearns the codebase. Atlas fixes that.
Atlas is a memory layer for coding agents. Fifteen MCP tools store memories on Walrus Mainnet, and verify Sui facts through Tatum.

Start a session, and Atlas returns the last summary, open tasks, and past decisions. Here, the agent recovers three tasks and the decision to keep SQLite as a disposable index. Before writing code, it knows where the last session stopped.
Save a memory about a Sui package. Atlas writes it to Walrus Mainnet and returns a blob ID. Tatum checks the object: a package, immutable, version one. The memory carries its own provenance.
The dashboard shows blob links and verified badges.
Ask in plain language, and semantic search finds the memory, with the same proof attached.
Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex share one project memory.
Atlas. Memory that outlives the session.
